content: The wolf that stays curled in its warm lair never tastes meat.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Sjaldan liggjandi úlfr lær um getr (Hávamál, Stanza 58) — Poetic Edda
explanation: Comfort is the cemetery of ambition. Staying warm beneath the furs feels safe and cozy, but out on the frozen tundra is where life is pursued, tested, and won. If you want sustenance and achievement, you must leave the comfort of the den and venture into the frost.
practicalInsight: Break out of your comfortable cocoon today. Step into the cold arena of action where the real work happens.
reflectionPrompt: Where is your love of comfortable security keeping you trapped in a den of mediocrity?
